_comment: Minimum scores for the offline eval suites, enforced in CI by tests/test_eval_gate.py. Set a little below measured values (see docs/EVALUATION.md) so regressions fail and intended improvements can raise the bar. Holdout is scored with rules the golden set never tuned. retrieval_hybrid floors are provisional: they were set from the BM25 measurement because the embedding model couldn't be downloaded when the catalog-only index was built; raise them after the first CI run. router_holdout.intent_accuracy was lowered from 0.85 to 0.75 when 7 knowledge-base questions were added to the holdout set: the rules miss paraphrases ("take it again", "when do spring classes start") that the LLM router is for; they were not tuned on. kb floors apply once the knowledge base has been crawled; until then the gate skips.
